notes.text: Allergic to chicken — kibble from home only.
notes.author: Front desk

notes.text: Pulls hard on the lead near the gate; use the harness.
notes.author: Walker: Dana

notes.text: Owner called: fine to extend a night if needed, will confirm by noon. Please also give the blue squeaky toy at bedtime — he won't settle without it and tends to bark at the kennel door for a good half hour otherwise.
notes.author: Front desk

notes.text: Extra blanket at night — he runs cold.
notes.author: Front desk
